name: mcf-linter-spark
description: Fast mcfunction linter with IMP-Doc support for Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.4 data packs

mcfLinterSpark.ignore.description: Resource id patterns (for example "animated_java:**") whose files are analysed but get no diagnostics.

mcfLinterSpark.maxDepth.description: How many directory levels below the workspace folder are searched for data packs. Unset: 2, or any depth when the folder has a spyglass.json.

mcfLinterSpark.serverPath.description: Path to an mcf-linter-spark executable to use instead of the bundled one.

scripts.package: pnpm run build && node scripts/copy-server.mjs && pnpm dlx @vscode/vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
